## Activity

During April 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 111 captures. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading performance for the month. The reported total reflects the captures completed at the site during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 8 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.2 per cent. The result is noted for routine monitoring of image acquisition and quality. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This measure records the typical interval for graded images during April 2024 and supports ongoing review of the service’s grading timeliness.

The activity, image quality and grading results should be considered together when reviewing site operations. The findings provide a summary of work completed at Hill Counties Health Centre during the month.
